title: Sign in with an emailed code

checks.name: a browser that bought without a password opens the sign-in on the code, prefilled
the sign-in view leads with the emailed code and hides the optional password
the page asks AuthFor for a code for exactly that email, naming WeylandAI
AuthFor's answer: sent, WeylandAI's mail, an 8-digit code for 15 minutes, a request id and no code
the page moves to the code step and says where the code went
checks.detail: {"codeShown":true,"note":"We emailed a sign-in code to jmobleyworks+wa-code-g040@gmail.com. It works for 15 minutes. If it has not arrived in a minute, check spam or send a new code.","resendDisabled":true,"emailLocked":true}

checks.name: 'Send a new code' waits while AuthFor would refuse another (resend_after)
checks.detail: {"codeShown":true,"note":"We emailed a sign-in code to jmobleyworks+wa-code-g040@gmail.com. It works for 15 minutes. If it has not arrived in a minute, check spam or send a new code.","resendDisabled":true,"emailLocked":true}

checks.name: a wrong code is refused by AuthFor (401 CODE_INVALID) and the page says so with the tries left
checks.detail: {"status":401,"code":"CODE_INVALID","attempts_left":4,"error":"That code does not match the latest one sent to jmobleyworks+wa-code-g040@gmail.com. 4 tries left. Check the email, or send a new code.","auth":"signed-out"}

checks.name: the emailed code was read from the alias's inbox
the right code from the inbox signs the visitor in at AuthFor (200, inbox proven)
the page says it is signed in as the alias, has no WeylandAI account yet, and offers the free trial
checks.detail: {"auth":"no-account","offer":"WEYLANDAI Finish setup Close No WeylandAI account on this email yet You are signed in as jmobleyworks+wa-code-g040@gmail.com. Start a free 14-day trial on it. No card needed and no automatic charge. START MY FREE 14-DAY TRIALUse a different"}

checks.name: stayed in place: same document, still on weylandai.com
